findings.title: Off-by-one error in totalPages when user_count is a multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. Whenever `user_count` is a positive multiple of `limit` (e.g. 50 members with `limit = 50`), `totalPages` evaluates to `2` instead of `1`. As a result, the page counter displays `1/2`, `showingLast` remains `false`, and clicking `next` sets `offset` to `50` and loads an empty page. It should use `Math.ceil(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit"))` (or `Math.floor((this.get("user_count") - 1) / this.get("limit")) + 1`).

findings.title: Offset is not clamped below total count when reloading members after deletion
findings.body: In `findMembers`, `offset` is computed as `Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))`, and `GroupsController#members` applies `params[:offset].to_i` directly without clamping it to the new `total`. If an admin is on the last page with a single member (e.g. 51st member at `offset = 50`, `limit = 50`) and removes that member, `removeMember` calls `findMembers()` with `offset = 50` while the group now has 50 members. The server returns an empty `members` array with `meta.total = 50` and `meta.offset = 50`, leaving the admin viewing an empty page even though 50 members remain in the group.

findings.title: Group creation ignores alias_level parameter
findings.body: The admin group form (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs`) renders the `alias_level` combo-box when creating a new group, and `Discourse.Group#create` sends `alias_level` in its POST payload via `asJSON()`. However, `Admin::GroupsController#create` only assigns `group.name` and `group.visible` and ignores `params[:alias_level]` (unlike `update`, which sets `group.alias_level = params[:alias_level].to_i if params[:alias_level].present?`). Any alias level selected during group creation is silently discarded.

findings.title: Adding an existing member in add_members raises a duplicate key error
findings.body: `add_members` splits `usernames` and calls `group.add(user)` for each found user without checking whether the user is already a member of `group` (or listed more than once in `usernames`). Because the new member list is paginated and the user-selector autocomplete does not exclude current group members, adding a user who is already in the group will attempt to insert a duplicate `group_users` record and fail with `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` (HTTP 500).

findings.title: Public group members page is truncated to 50 members with no pagination
findings.body: `GroupsController#members` now limits results to 50 members by default for all groups, and `GroupMembersRoute` calls `model.findMembers()` which only fetches the first 50 members (`limit: 50, offset: 0`). Unlike the admin group template, the public group members view (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs`) has no pagination or load-more mechanism, so any group with more than 50 members can no longer display members beyond the first 50.

findings.title: Unvalidated limit and offset parameters in GroupsController#members
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly to `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` without bounds checking. Passing a negative `limit` or `offset` in the query string raises an unhandled `ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid` (`PG::InvalidRowCountInLimitClause` / `PG::InvalidRowCountInResultOffsetClause`, HTTP 500), and there is no upper cap on `limit`.

findings.title: remove_member spec uses PUT instead of DELETE
findings.body: In the `.remove_member` spec context, the test `'cannot remove members from automatic groups'` invokes `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, whereas `remove_member` is routed via `DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members` (`xhr :delete`).
